purpose: Tolerance-boundary cases shown numerically on BOTH sides: (a) a near-end bar high sitting just inside y_hat+eps (dominated, line survives) vs a counterfactual just outside (INVALID_PIERCE); and (b) a final close just below y_hat+eps_break (not a breakout candidate) vs a counterfactual just above (breakout).

params.eps_break_note: eps_break=0.01 is ILLUSTRATIVE, not locked (HD-03, §13.5); this fixture explicitly probes the eps_break boundary to show it is a versioned/backtestable knob.

rejection_rationale.candidate: eps boundary — the t=28 high (87.90) INVALIDATING the line (INVALID_PIERCE)
rejection_rationale.rejected_because: The t=28 high sits just INSIDE y_hat(28)+eps, so it is dominated-within-tolerance and the line stays ACTIVE. (It is a validity-only bar: within k of the series end it cannot be a confirmed pivot, so it never re-selects B*.)

rejection_rationale.candidate: eps_break boundary — the t=30 close (86.10) being a BREAKOUT candidate
rejection_rationale.rejected_because: The final close is just BELOW y_hat(30)+eps_break, so it is NOT a breakout candidate; the line remains ACTIVE.
rejection_rationale.numeric: ln(86.10)=4.455494 < y_hat(30)+eps_break=4.447129+0.01=4.457129 (miss by 0.001635). Counterfactual: C=86.40 -> ln=4.458973 > 4.457129 -> WOULD be a breakout candidate (BROKEN_OUT), confirmed_bar==breakout_bar==30 (HD-03).

rejection_rationale.rejected_because: Its high does not exceed y_hat(28)+eps, so it is a within-envelope overshoot, not even a wick-break.
rejection_rationale.numeric: ln(87.90)=4.475948 <= 4.477665 -> no eps pierce -> not WICK_BREAK.

key_inequalities: B*=(20,90) is the unambiguous shallow-hull anchor; all intervening pivots sit below the line.
eps boundary (validity): ln(H[28])=4.475948 vs y_hat(28)+eps=4.477665 -> INSIDE by 0.001717 (dominated).
eps_break boundary (breakout): ln(C[30])=4.455494 vs y_hat(30)+eps_break=4.457129 -> BELOW by 0.001635 (no candidate).
Both counterfactual perturbations (H=88.10; C=86.40) flip the outcome, pinning the exact decision thresholds.
geometry_check.notes: The t=28 bar is deliberately within k=3 of the series end so it is a validity-only bar (D-TL-05: selection uses pivots, validity uses every bar high) and cannot re-select the envelope. This isolates the eps domination boundary from hull re-selection.
